  WHY: A more durable alternative would be to exec the embedded Python in a throwaway namespace and read the constants off `globals()`, but that is well beyond this round's scope. This was flagged by minimax/minimax-m3 in pass 1 as a NIT and remains a NIT here.

The consensus cross-pollination marked this as an accepted residual rather than a deferred requirement, so no TASK_GAP is raised here.
